name: minedesk
description: MineDesk - authorized remote desktop and remote support platform

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @minedesk/api && npm run build -w @minedesk/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @minedesk/api && npm run test -w @minedesk/web
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis coturn
